subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

In a school party, six girls are sitting in a circle facing the centre. Pragathi is sitting to the immediate left of Keerthi. Kavya is an immediate neighbour of both Pragathi and Vaishali. Meghana is an immediate neighbour of both Keerthi and Vasantha.

Who is sitting to immediate left of Vaishali?
solution:
Six girls are sitting in a circle facing the centre.

 

1) Pragathi is sitting to the immediate left of Keerthi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4fbd59e104e6fea8064f170b213f3853ab85dcac967e133f6aeb969a2f43015.png] 

2) Kavya is an immediate neighbour of both Pragathi and Vaishali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69775895beb3ab68cd587c130ab260a4106adb69892f80a0869c2f1f65cfe87e.png] 

3) Meghana is an immediate neighbour of both Keerthi and Vasantha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4097725e423f9c9d2f25fd7cabb0ae02861bd71b2164b54a495314016cfe2ea9.png] 

Hence, “**Vasantha**” is sitting to immediate left of Vaishali.
